第29章 法则天赋的全部结果（第1页）
林云仔细看完全部内容后，便迫不及待地开始感悟力量法则。
在法则感悟的过程中，时间如同无声的细流，悄然消逝。
当林云缓缓睁开双眼，力量法则的感悟已然成功！
林云惊讶不已，随即立刻算起时间。
“你上去看看，少奶奶忙完了没有？”
君陌殇弯腰，从置物柜里取了煮面的锅出来。
苏紫韵忙着点菜，杜传蓉一心拍摄，江远则已经拉开椅子坐了下来。
君天衡身形一僵，喉咙肿胀，全身的血液迅速冲上头顶，持枪的手不可抑制地晃动。
他带着顾若琪去往西影岛，虽然是为了接触君行舟，却也是真心想要顾若琪在那里安心养胎。
“胡说，你就是想骗我起床，梨梨子才不会上当辣！”
梨梨子使出了吃奶的劲，憋红了脸，硬要去拖拽床单。
三番四次勾搭，甚至想要以身博上位。
顾灼辰并没有想在这个时候动手，他知道此时的项卓是最警惕的。
当然，他心里也清楚，全垒打也只是迟早的事情，前期就当玩情调了。
思及此，她给君陌殇发了一条信息，让君行舟明天回一趟君家老宅。
接下来，苏北该让这些旧时代的残党老登们，尝一尝新时代的铁拳是什么滋味了。
更令她自得的是，这次回家之后，她的身份有了质的变化。

她成了一名带薪酬的光荣的幕后工作者。
除了皇上和父亲，没有人知道她的贵妃到底怎么来的，更没有人知道这些年她到底是如何宠冠后宫的，就连身边一直伺候的金玉都不知道。
那颗糖在他们唇齿间融化、脆裂，直至慢慢消失，只剩下甜甜的余味，久久仍然在他们间交融。
云邵俊双膝跪地，已经泪流满面，他已经是两世为人，前世，他没有孝敬过母亲一天就与母亲阴阳两隔了，母亲孤苦一生，活的是个凄惨，后来也被胡氏磋磨死的。
所幸云华等人都是修为比较高的，也能各自挡下，封锁阳也护着邵雅雅后退了几步。
她端着这份牛排去见他时，心里是忐忑的，毕竟卖相不那么好看，边缘还煎得焦糊了。
他们因着要见礼迎了出来，两位大人物没有发话，此刻也不好离开。
如此都只能耽搁在这里，硬着头皮硬吃这个瓜了。
不过他们也是识时务的，有眼睛也能看到宁夏跟领队的元衡真君之间的关系，都十分和气地跟他们相互认识了一番，说了些体面话。
至于心里是怎么想的，也只有他们自己知道了。
苏纤绾闻言不由自主的笑出了声，这胡仙如是眼见讨好她不成，赶着去讨好纪幽冉了。
“你可以帮我把他的修为给废掉？那真是太好了”
慕玦寒只来得及看见那个邋遢男人故意没有扣住安遥的一根扣子，然后借口下一个工作人员带安遥准备跳，嘴里还说着其他都已经准备好了。
“没关系，他不是，有人是就行了。”
楚昊然微微一笑，看向了旁边的狼。
林风能从华国找到矮国问他要人就说明已经掌握了一些事，而且他的手段不一般，马方安此时不敢得罪。

Chapter 29 All results of law talent (page 1)
After Lin Yun carefully read the entire content, he couldn't wait to understand the law of power.
In the process of understanding the law, time passes quietly like a silent trickle.
When Lin Yun slowly opened his eyes, he had successfully realized the law of power!
Lin Yun was surprised and immediately counted the time.
"Go up and see if the young lady is finished?"
Jun Moshang bent down and took out the pot for cooking noodles from the locker.
Su Ziyun was busy ordering food, Du Chuanrong was focused on taking pictures, and Jiang Yuan had already pulled out a chair and sat down.
Jun Tianheng's body froze, his throat swelled, blood all over his body rushed to the top of his head, and the hand holding the gun shook uncontrollably.
He took Gu Ruoqi to Xiying Island. Although it was to get in touch with Jun Xingzhou, he also really wanted Gu Ruoqi to raise her baby there in peace.
"Nonsense, you just want to trick me into getting up, Lilizi won't be fooled!"
Lilizi tried her best to suck the milk, suppressed her blush, and insisted on dragging the sheets.
They hooked up again and again, and even wanted to use their bodies to win positions.
Gu Zhuochen didn't want to take action at this time. He knew that Xiang Zhuo was the most vigilant at this time.
Of course, he also knew in his heart that a home run would only happen sooner or later, and he treated it as a flirtation in the early stage.
Thinking of this, she sent a message to Jun Moshang, asking Jun Xingzhou to go back to the Jun family's old house tomorrow.
Next, it is time for Northern Jiangsu to let these remnants of the old era have a taste of what the iron fist of the new era is like.
What makes her even more proud is that after returning home this time, her identity has changed qualitatively.
She became a paid and glorious behind-the-scenes worker.
Except for the emperor and her father, no one knew how her concubine came to be, and no one knew how she had been favored in the harem all these years. Not even Jin Yu, who had been waiting around her, knew.
The candy melted and cracked between their lips and teeth until it slowly disappeared, leaving only a sweet aftertaste that still blended between them for a long time.
Yun Shaojun knelt on his knees, with tears streaming down his face. He had been a human being for two lives. In his previous life, he did not show filial piety to his mother and was separated from her in just one day. Her mother lived a lonely life and lived a miserable life. Later, she was tortured to death by the Hu family.
Fortunately, Yun Hua and the others were all relatively advanced in cultivation and were able to block each other. Seoul Yang also protected Shao Yaya and took a few steps back.
When she brought the steak to see him, she felt uneasy. After all, it didn't look that good and the edges were burnt.
They came out because they wanted to be greeted. The two big men didn't say anything, and it was difficult to leave at this moment.
In this case, we can only stay here and bite the bullet and eat this melon.
However, they were also aware of current affairs and could see the relationship between Ning Xia and the leader of the team, Zhenjun Yuan Heng. They all got to know each other very kindly and said some decent words to them.
As for what they think in their hearts, only they themselves know.
Su Xianwan couldn't help laughing when she heard this. Hu Xianru saw that he couldn't please her, so he rushed to please Ji Youran.
"You can help me destroy his cultivation? That would be great."
Mu Juehan only had time to see that the sloppy man deliberately failed to fasten any of An Yao's buttons, and then used the excuse of the next staff member to take An Yao to prepare for the dance, saying that everything else was ready.
"It doesn't matter, he's not, as long as someone is."
Chu Haoran smiled slightly and looked at the wolf next to him.
The fact that Lin Feng was able to find Di Guo from Hua and ask him for someone showed that he had mastered something, and his methods were extraordinary. Ma Fangan did not dare to offend him at this time.
